one_month_reasoning: The window to 2026-11-08 probably contains the Q3 2026 report, but the date is not yet announced: EDGAR shows no 8-K after Aug 5, 2026, and last year the notice came Oct 15 with results Nov 5 after the close. I put ~85% on a print inside the window. The founder's 10b5-1 sales cannot start before the later of Dec 1, 2026 or the Q3 10-Q (Schedule 13D/A No. 21), so they fall outside the window. The raised FY26 guide (midpoint $2.2045B less H1 $1,103.1M) implies H2 revenue of ~$1,101M, about +6% y/y against Q2's +9.8%, so the revenue bar is low. But the stock is near its $244.98 high, consensus moved up after the Aug 6 +23.55% re-rating, and the $105M float-income guide already assumes rates hold (the Sep 16 Fed hike is a small tailwind). So I do not call the direction. Model: 85% weight on an earnings-month lognormal with sigma 14.5% and median $232.8, plus 15% on a no-print month at sigma 10%. The blend is slightly wider than 46%/3.5 = 13.1% because PAYC's earnings-day moves are large (+23.55% on Aug 6). P(>= spot) is 0.507.

fair_value.method: Blend of P/E (65%): Oct-2027 NTM EPS $15.02 x 17.0x HCM/payroll peer median = $255. And a DCF (35%): normalized 2026 FCF of $575M (ex the $74.8M tax refund), FCF less 2.9% SBC, 9.0% WACC, 3% terminal growth, $702M net debt less $584M retained FCF, 45.07M shares = $261. 0.65 x 255 + 0.35 x 261 = $257.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at 2027-10-09 $15.02 = 0.25 x FY27 consensus $13.97 + 0.75 x FY28E $15.37; x 17.0x (HCM/payroll/PEO peer median 16.99x, 9 peers; 17.09x without ASUR) = $255.

inputs_detail.derivation: $13.97 x 1.10. Roughly 7% revenue growth (FY27 consensus +7.44%; FY26 recurring guide +8-9%), plus ~1pt of margin leverage (FY26 adj. EBITDA guide ~46% vs Q2 44.2%), plus ~3% net share reduction. That is ~$615M FY27 levered FCF (estimate, see DCF) less ~$68M dividends, about $547M of buybacks at ~$240, or 2.3M shares (5.1% of 45.07M), less ~1.5-2% SBC dilution (SBC 2.9% of revenue). Interest on the $900M revolver is already in the FY27 base, so I take no further deduction. 7 + 1 + 3 = ~11%; I use 10% because the H1-2026 share shrink was debt-funded and cannot be repeated. [citation gate 2026-10-12: the ~$615M FY27 levered FCF behind the buyback term builds on the recap-only guide (see DCF).]

The HCM/payroll/PEO peer median is 16.99x (9 peers, 7.6x-22.1x; 17.09x without the ASUR micro-cap), and PAYC trades at 17.68x today. 17.0x is at the median. At the horizon PAYC's NTM EPS growth (~10%) is close to the peers' (ADP 9.5%, PAYX 7.5%, PCTY 10.3%), and its high margin is offset by revolver leverage and founder selling. The 2026 EPS boost from the debt-funded share shrink does not repeat, so no premium. 17.0 x $15.02 = $255.3. [citation gate 2026-10-12: the peer forward P/E figures and medians are StockAnalysis aggregator ratios (the pages show them, but the gate does not accept aggregator peer multiples and they are not reproducible from the same pages' consensus EPS). Rebuilt NTM P/E (Oct-9 close / time-weighted S&P Global consensus EPS): ADP 21.54, PAYX 17.01, PCTY 17.09, WDAY 14.86, INTU 12.34, TNET 13.33, BBSI 16.21, NSP 18.99, ASUR 7.13; core median 16.61x (16.21x with ASUR); PAYC 17.14x, not 17.68x. Agent multiple unchanged (judgment); the supervisor's numbers use 16.61x.]

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Valued at Oct-2027. Unlevered FCF: 2026 normalized $598M ($575M ex-tax-refund + ~$23M after-tax interest), +8% in 2027-28 and +7% in 2029-32. Less SBC at 2.9% of revenue: 2028 $624M, 2029 $668M, 2030 $715M, 2031 $765M, 2032 $818M. WACC 9.0%, terminal growth 3%: PV explicit $2.76B + PV terminal $9.13B = EV $11.89B. Horizon net debt = $702M less ~$584M FCF retained Jul-2026 to Oct-2027 = $118M. Equity $11.77B / 45.07M = $261. At a 9.5% WACC the value is $240; at 8.5% it is $286.

FY27 consensus revenue +7.44% ($2.37B), FY26 recurring guide +8-9%, and capex held near 6% of revenue (H1-26 capex $54.9M vs $99.4M a year earlier, src 2). Guide midpoint ($2.197-2.212B) and FY27 consensus $2.37B, then 7%.
H1-2026 SBC $31.6M / revenue $1,103.1M = 2.86% (10-Q cash-flow statement). This replaces my round-1 '~3% per CFO', which came from a transcript feed the gate cannot reopen.

Cost of equity 5.22% (10y UST, FRED) + 1.0 x 4.20% (Damodaran implied ERP, Oct 1, 2026) = 9.42%. I use beta 1.0 rather than the reported 5Y beta of 0.83 because realized vol is 46%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~5.9% (Term SOFR + 1.25-2.00%), 4.3% after a 27% tax rate. Weights: equity $10.47B (45.07M x $232.22), debt $0.90B. (10.47 x 9.42% + 0.90 x 4.3%) / 11.37 = 9.0%. [citation gate 2026-10-12: beta 0.83 is on source 26 (StockAnalysis statistics), not 25.]
Roughly nominal GDP: below the 5.22% risk-free rate and well below 2025 recurring growth of 10.3%. The implied terminal value is ~17x 2033 FCF less SBC.

Long-term debt $900.0M - cash $198.0M = $702.0M. The $82.8M of operating lease liabilities ($28.8M + $54.0M) is excluded because lease cost is already in operating cash flow. Round 1 used a lease-inclusive $785M and wrongly labelled it 'reported'.

H2-2026 levered FCF = $650M guide - H1 FCF ($427.6M OCF - $54.9M capex = $372.7M) = $277.3M. Jan-Oct 9 2027 = 0.775 x FY27 levered FCF $615M ($646M - $31M after-tax interest) = $477M. Less 5 dividends of $0.375 x 45.07M = $84.5M. Less SBC dilution over the window, 2.9% x ($1,102M H2-26 + $1,837M Jan-Oct-27 revenue) = $85M. Result: $584M, credited to net debt because the share count is held at 45.07M. [citation gate 2026-10-12: H2-26 FCF of $277.3M uses the recap-only guide; on primary data H2-26 is ~$276.7M and the total ~$581M. The DCF leg would be ~$259.6 instead of $261.]

bear.story: AI-disruption worries about seat-based HCM return, or the Feb-2027 guide shows recurring growth slipping to ~5-6% as the expanded sales force under-delivers. The 2026 margin step-up proves partly one-off: Q2 GAAP R&D fell to $51.9M from $74.8M, and SBC fell to $17.6M from $38.4M. Founder 10b5-1 selling of up to 1.09M shares (Dec 2026 to Jun 2027) and $900M of revolver debt weigh on the multiple. Result: ~11-12x on ~$13.3 NTM EPS, giving back the whole post-Q2 re-rating (pre-print closes were $164-175).

base.story: Recurring growth runs 7-9% and the adj. EBITDA margin holds ~46%. Buybacks continue under the no-expiry $2B plan ($1.66B left), but more slowly at today's price, and EPS compounds ~10%. The stock holds ~16x on ~$15 NTM EPS. A Hold-rated street (avg PT $220) and founder supply keep it a little below my $257 fair value.

bull.story: New modules (Asset Management, Career & Succession) and the sales expansion lift recurring growth back to 10%+. The cost savings management attributes to self-hosted AI models (no dollar figure I can verify at a public source) keep R&D down, margins push toward 48%, and FY27 EPS beats $13.97. The stock earns ~20x on ~$15.5 NTM EPS.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$150 (-35%) the stock would sit at ~10.7x FY27 consensus EPS of $13.97. That is below every core peer (lowest INTU 12.64x) and below all the closes before the Q2 print ($163.96-$175.30, Jul 31-Aug 5), so the whole post-Q2 re-rating would be gone. It would also be near the ~$130 average price of the H1-2026 buybacks ($1,419.8M / 10.9M shares). Most likely cause: the Feb-2027 guide or a quarterly print shows recurring growth falling toward ~5%, revenue retention slipping from 91%, or the 2026 margin step-up reversing. Leverage is not the trigger: net debt is ~$702M against roughly $1B of 2026 adj. EBITDA guidance and a 3.5x covenant. Ordinary 46% volatility seldom moves the stock this far with fundamentals intact.

reasoning: Round 2 keeps the primary-document read and corrects four points the supervisor raised, each re-checked at its source. (1) Net debt for the FCF DCF is $702M ($900.0M revolver - $198.0M cash, 10-Q), not the lease-inclusive $785M I mislabelled 'reported'. (2) The >$650M 2026 FCF guide (TipRanks call recap) includes a one-off +$74.8M 'income taxes, net' inflow in H1 OCF (10-Q; receivable $78.2M -> $3.4M), so the normalized base is ~$575M, matching TTM FCF of $575.1M. (3) SBC is now the 10-Q actual, 2.9% of revenue. (4) The '$100M R&D / $30M AI-fee savings' and '~100 reps' figures came from a key-gated transcript feed, so they are out of every number. The verified fact is Q2 GAAP R&D of $51.9M vs $74.8M (8-K Ex.99.1). I also dropped TYL/BR/JKHY from the comps and added BBSI (16.99x, verified), giving a 9-peer HCM/payroll/PEO median of 16.99x. I corrected the float-income catalyst: the Fed hiked on Sep 16, it did not cut. Valuation: P/E $255 (unchanged; 17.0x at the median on $15.02 NTM EPS). The DCF falls from $285 to $261. It is less than the supervisor's ~$245-255 expectation because I credit ~$584M of FCF retained from Jul-2026 to Oct-2027 to net debt while holding shares at 45.07M, which is consistent with a horizon valuation. Blend: $257, from $266. Scenarios: bear $155 / 25%, base $242 / 50%, bull $310 / 25%, each lognormal (sigma 17-24%). That gives a mean of ~$237.5, a median of ~$236 and a log-sd of ~0.32, with tails fattened slightly toward the 46% realized vol. P(>=232) falls from 0.55 to 0.525. The modest positive drift reflects EPS compounding and buybacks, held back by a Hold-rated street (avg PT $220), founder supply and AI-multiple risk. Research was limited to re-checking filings and public pages. www.sec.gov refused a plain scripted request, so I read the filings with WebFetch, and the prepared-remarks PDF was only partly machine-readable. No option prices or implied volatility were used.
